name: Cambridge
description: The university town where a rising on 19 June 1381 targeted the University's privileged corporate status; Corpus Christi College was ransacked and the University's library and archives burned in the town square, reportedly to the cry 'Away with the learning of clerks, away with it,' led in part by a townswoman, Margery Starre.
story_hooks: The Cambridge rising against the University, 19 June 1381
